cards.korean_desc: 김정은이 새 압록강 다리를 건너 중국 단둥을 깜짝 방문했습니다. 한반도 외교에 다시 관심이 모이고 있습니다.
cards.english_desc: Kim Jong-un made a surprise visit to Dandong, China, by crossing the new Yalu River bridge. Attention is returning to diplomacy on the Korean Peninsula.
cards.hook: A new bridge, a surprise trip, and plenty of diplomatic suspense.

cards.english_title: Quiet Seoul Comes Alive at Night
cards.korean_desc: 운현궁에서 방문객들이 전통 디저트를 만들고 차를 마십니다. 가야금 연주를 들으며 이야기도 나눕니다.
cards.english_desc: At Unhyeongung, visitors make traditional desserts and drink tea. They also share stories while listening to gayageum music.
cards.hook: Tea, desserts, and gayageum turn history into an evening hangout.

cards.english_title: A New Gateway Between North Korea and China
cards.korean_desc: 새 압록강 다리가 북한과 중국을 연결하는 새로운 통로가 됐습니다. 두 나라의 이동과 교류가 늘어날지 관심이 큽니다.
cards.english_desc: The new Yalu River bridge has become a new route connecting North Korea and China. Many are watching to see whether travel and exchanges between the countries will grow.
cards.hook: One bridge could change how two neighbors connect.

cards.korean_desc: 김정은이 새 압록강 다리를 통해 중국 단둥에 도착했습니다. 한국 통일부가 이 사실을 밝혔습니다.
cards.english_desc: Kim Jong-un arrived in Dandong, China, through the new Yalu River bridge. South Korea’s Unification Ministry announced the news.
cards.hook: The bridge opened, and a major visitor crossed first.

cards.korean_desc: 하나금융그룹이 올해 첫 9개월 동안 3조 6200억 원의 순이익을 냈습니다. 자사주 매입과 소각도 사상 최대 수준에 가까웠습니다.
cards.english_desc: Hana Financial Group posted 3.62 trillion won in net profit during the first nine months of the year. Its share buybacks and cancellations also nearly reached a record level.
cards.hook: Big profits meet even bigger shareholder returns.

cards.english_title: Woori Financial Profit Tops One Trillion Won
cards.korean_desc: 우리금융그룹이 9개월 동안 2조 6600억 원의 순이익을 기록했습니다. 일회성 이익을 제외하면 실적은 지난해보다 좋아졌습니다.
cards.english_desc: Woori Financial Group recorded 2.66 trillion won in net profit over nine months. Excluding one-time gains, its performance improved from last year.
cards.hook: The headline dips, but the underlying numbers rise.

cards.korean_title: 서울 증시, 저가 매수로 소폭 상승
cards.korean_desc: 한국 주식이 전날 큰 폭으로 떨어진 뒤 소폭 상승했습니다. 투자자들은 반도체 주식을 저렴하게 사들였습니다.
cards.english_desc: South Korean stocks rose slightly after falling sharply the previous day. Investors bought chip stocks at lower prices.
cards.hook: After a rough day, bargain hunters went shopping.

cards.english_title: Groups Urge Firms to Update Cybersecurity
cards.korean_desc: 암참과 시스코가 오래된 IT 시스템의 보안 위험을 경고했습니다. 한국 기업에 시스템을 현대화하라고 촉구했습니다.
cards.english_desc: AmCham and Cisco warned about the security risks of outdated IT systems. They urged Korean companies to modernize their systems.
cards.hook: Old computers may be inviting new cyber trouble.

cards.english_title: Is Korea’s Black Puffer Era Ending?
cards.korean_desc: 한국 겨울 거리에서 검은 패딩이 오랫동안 인기를 끌었습니다. 최근 아이돌들이 다양한 색의 패딩을 입으며 변화가 보입니다.
cards.english_desc: Black puffers have long been popular on Korean winter streets. Recently, idols have appeared in colorful puffers, suggesting a change.
cards.hook: Winter fashion may finally be ready for more than black.

cards.english_title: A Quieter Seoul Comes Alive at Night
cards.korean_desc: 운현궁에서 가을밤 차와 대화를 즐기는 행사가 열립니다. 방문객들은 전통 간식을 만들고 가야금 음악도 듣습니다.
cards.english_desc: Unhyeongung is hosting autumn evening events with tea and conversation. Visitors can make traditional snacks and listen to gayageum music.
cards.hook: A royal residence now offers a very relaxing night out.

cards.english_title: Jinyoung Makes the Case for Slow Reading
cards.korean_desc: 진영은 아이돌이 된 뒤 반복적인 생활로 마음이 지쳤습니다. 그는 책을 천천히 읽으며 생각을 다시 깨웠습니다.
cards.english_desc: After becoming an idol, Jinyoung felt tired of his repetitive life. Reading books slowly helped wake up his thoughts again.
cards.hook: Could reading slower make your mind move faster?

cards.korean_desc: 서울의 한 카페에서 매우 희귀한 원두로 만든 고급 커피를 판매합니다. 한 잔의 가격은 최대 350만 원입니다.
cards.english_desc: A Seoul café sells luxury coffee made with exceptionally rare beans. One cup can cost up to 3.5 million won.
cards.hook: When coffee costs millions, every sip needs a story.

cards.english_title: South Korea to Face Saudi Arabia and Qatar
cards.korean_desc: 한국 축구 대표팀이 11월에 사우디아라비아와 카타르와 친선 경기를 합니다. 두 경기는 카타르 도하에서 열립니다.
cards.english_desc: South Korea’s national football team will play friendlies against Saudi Arabia and Qatar in November. Both matches will take place in Doha, Qatar.
cards.hook: Two friendlies, two tests, and one busy November.

cards.korean_desc: 조은혜가 여자 에페 B 개인전에서 금메달을 땄습니다. 한국은 장애인아시안게임 펜싱에서 처음으로 금메달을 얻었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Cho Eun-hye won gold in the women’s individual epee B event. South Korea earned its first Asian Para Games fencing gold medal.
cards.hook: A one-point victory made history for Korean fencing.

cards.korean_desc: 2010년 브리티시 오픈 우승자인 루이 오스트하위즌이 LIV 골프를 떠납니다. 그는 이번 결정이 인생에서 가장 어려운 결정 중 하나라고 말했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Louis Oosthuizen, the 2010 British Open champion, will leave LIV Golf. He said the decision was one of the hardest of his life.
cards.hook: A major champion is choosing a different fairway.

cards.korean_desc: 바이에른 뮌헨이 아스널과 2 대 2로 비겼습니다. 김민재는 선발로 나와 전반전만 뛰었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Bayern Munich drew 2-2 with Arsenal. Kim Min-jae started the match but played only the first half.
cards.hook: Four goals, one half for Kim, and no winner.

cards.korean_desc: 산토스 브라보스가 데뷔 1주년을 맞아 11월 20일 새 음원을 발표합니다. 이번 음원은 그룹의 새 활동을 알리는 곡입니다.
cards.english_desc: Santos Bravos will release new music on November 20 to celebrate its first anniversary. The release begins a new activity period for the group.
cards.hook: One year old, and already bringing a new musical surprise.

cards.korean_desc: TWS가 두 번째 실물 싱글을 11월 2일 발표합니다. 앨범에는 팬들이 즐길 수 있는 조명이 포함됩니다.
cards.english_desc: TWS will release its second physical single on November 2. The album includes lighting that fans can enjoy.
cards.hook: This single comes with a little extra glow.

cards.korean_desc: 아이들의 민니가 첫 솔로 디지털 EP의 일부를 공개했습니다. 세 곡 모두 작사에 참여해 다양한 감정을 담았습니다.
cards.english_desc: Minnie of I-dle released previews from her first solo digital EP. She helped write all three songs, which express different emotions.
cards.hook: Three songs, many feelings, and Minnie behind every line.

cards.korean_desc: 아일릿의 새 EP가 스포티파이 사전 저장 50만 건을 넘었습니다. 앨범은 월요일에 공식 발표됩니다.
cards.english_desc: Illit’s new EP has surpassed 500,000 Spotify pre-saves. The album will be officially released on Monday.
cards.hook: Half a million listeners are waiting before release day.

cards.korean_title: PHP 보안 결함에 해킹 시도 급증
cards.english_title: Hacking Attempts Surge After PHP Flaws
cards.korean_desc: PHP의 심각한 보안 결함이 공개되자 해킹 시도가 크게 늘었습니다. 기업과 정부는 서둘러 시스템을 고치고 있습니다.
cards.english_desc: Hacking attempts surged after serious PHP security flaws were disclosed. Companies and governments are rushing to fix their systems.
cards.hook: A tiny software flaw can open a very large door.

cards.korean_desc: 2025년 해외 한국어 수업 학생 수가 19만 1896명에 달했습니다. 한국어 수업은 47개국 2777개 학교에서 운영됐습니다.
cards.english_desc: In 2025, 191,896 students took Korean-language classes overseas. Korean classes were offered at 2,777 schools in 47 countries.
cards.hook: Korean class is going global, one classroom at a time.

cards.korean_desc: 뉴멕시코 법원이 메타에 250억 달러를 지급하라고 명령했습니다. 배심원단은 메타가 이용자 개인정보에 대해 소비자를 속였다고 판단했습니다.
cards.english_desc: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion. A jury found that Meta misled consumers about the privacy of their data.
cards.hook: Privacy claims just turned into a massive bill.

cards.english_title: Early Voting Rises in Key Senate States
cards.korean_desc: 미국 상원 주도권을 결정할 가능성이 큰 주에서 사전투표가 늘고 있습니다. 텍사스에서는 2022년보다 74% 증가했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Early voting is increasing in states that could decide control of the US Senate. In Texas, it is up 74 percent from 2022.
cards.hook: The Senate race may be decided before Election Day arrives.
